messages.subject: Error in compilingNimble
parts:
Hi! 
I am looking for some help on compiling a model in Nimble. I am running it on Mac OS Catalina, and have Xcode installed. When trying to run the command 'compileNimble(model)', I get the error message: compiling... this may take a minute. Use 'showCompilerOutput = TRUE' to see C++ compilation details.
Error: Failed to create the shared library. Run 'printErrors()' to see the compilation errors.

When running print Errors, this is what is shown: sh: make: command not found
Warning message:
In system(cmd) : error in running command

Would really appreciate some help on this as it is my first time using Nimble!

Thanks,
Jemisha

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Error in compilingNimble
parts:
hi Jemisha,

'make' should be installed when you install the command line tools. Can you try to run the following three commands from a Terminal on your Mac?

which gcc
which make
echo $PATH

The first command checks whether you have the gcc compiler installed and where it is. The second checks for make. The third will list the directories on your machine where the shell will look for executables. Hopefully based on that output we can help you diagnose whether make is installed and if so, where it is.

-Chris
